comments.text: Norway took the idea and method from Kuwait in 1990 before the savage Iraq's invasion of Kuwait by few months of period, Kuwait was the first country to establish a sovereign fund in the world

replies.author: @WhereonEarth4K
replies.text: Worth a small correction on timing - Kuwait actually established its sovereign wealth fund (the Kuwait Investment Authority) back in 1953, making it the world's first by several decades, well before the 1990 invasion. Norway's fund came much later, in the 1990s.
